notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Oculus Touch Support:
Lazerbait now has some basic Oculus Touch support. All of the controls map over pretty smoothly, and controller UI attachments are generally in the right place now.

Explosion Colors:
When upgrading to the latest version of Unity, some of the shaders I used in the ship explosion particle effect got broken. However, it gave explosions a cool cartoony effect. So I took it one step further and made explosions have colors based on the player color of the exploding ship. Hope you like them!

Bug Fix:
There was an unfortunate bug in the first version of the game which caused the leaderboards to get a bit corrupted by giving people points for beating AI occasionally when they didn't actually beat the AI. This has been fixed going forward and I apologize for the minor corruption in the leaderboards.


Special thanks for everyone who has played Lazerbait. I don't make any money from this game and I intend to keep it that way. However, I do love getting reviews and feedback. So if you feel like supporting Lazerbait, please feel free to leave a review! :-)
